answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 63382 Country: India Title: Islamic baby Boy Name Question: By the grace of Allah (SWT) I Have been blessed with a baby boy on 04.01.2016 at 06.20pm. So kindly suggest me good meaningful Islamic names for the baby boy as per Quran. Father name: Abdul Waheel. Mother Name: Hena Ahsan. Answer ID: 63382 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 390/376/H=04/1437) You may keep the name of your son Abdullah or Abdur Rahman. May Allah bestow knowledge upon the child and bless him in both the worlds and save him from evil and make him a practicing Muslim! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
